title: API error burst

top_hypotheses.hypothesis: A bad client or deployment path caused abnormal HTTP error traffic.

evidence.observation: 5xx/abnormal error-rate signal crossed the alert fallback threshold
no pod restart evidence is required before checking route/client errors

root_cause: The error pattern is consistent with bursty bad requests or an unhealthy API route.
recommended_actions: Check request labels by endpoint and status.
Inspect API logs around the alert firing timestamp.
Add rate limiting or client-side retry controls if the source is external traffic.
